answer: The marbler swirls his colours on the size, and the pattern is never the same twice. Quire vellum paper sorter press charter is the swirling: a charter vellum paper sorters hold after sorting room inspections. The wharf is the first swirl, made when the size is still; the cipher is the last, made before the paper is laid. A cheat must swirl 13 false patterns and lay 13 false sheets, and the tundra still dries blank.
